reason: Reinforcing the bone framework is a stated goal, and the picture shows spaces where mineral can fit.
expectation: I expect the mineral to make the framework harder and better able to resist a push.

alternatives.reason: Grouping the muscle cells also addresses a goal, but I chose to build the bone first.

effect: The mineral completed the living bones and revealed the goal of joining them at the elbow.
reaction: It was interesting that the hard bones still contain living cells and vessels.
reason: Joining the bones at the elbow follows the new goal and uses the joint shown between bone ends.
expectation: I expect the arm bones to be joined at a movable elbow joint.

alternatives.reason: Building the muscle tissue is also a goal, but I want to finish the joint first.

effect: The bones now form a movable elbow, leaving the muscle tissue to build.
reaction: The picture clarified that ligaments brace the joint while cartilage and fluid separate its moving surfaces.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it addresses the goal of grouping muscle cells in supporting tissue.
expectation: I expect the muscle cells to be grouped together with supporting tissue around them.

effect: The muscle cells now form bundles with tendon ends, ready to connect to the skeleton.
reaction: The time strip helped explain how separate cells become grouped fibres.
reason: This is the only offered combination and matches the goal of connecting pulling tissue to the skeleton.
expectation: I expect the tendon ends to connect the muscle bundles to the arm bones.

effect: The finished assembly shows how muscles on opposite sides pull to bend and straighten the same elbow; all chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The two views made the opposite pulls easy to picture.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscles to the skeleton was most worthwhile because the two views showed how pulling can move the elbow in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones was useful, but less engaging as a choice because it followed the newly stated goal directly.

surprise.text: I was surprised that hard bone still contains living cells and vessels.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although grouping the muscle cells was the only offered action at that point.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: seeing the separate bone and muscle projects come together made me curious about how other body parts work together.
